description: Join the meeting room 'NoisyCafe'. Enable the 'Push-to-Talk' feature in the settings. Verify it works by taking three screenshots: 1) The Settings dialog showing 'Push to talk' enabled (save to ~/ptt_settings.png), 2) The meeting view showing the microphone muted (inactive state) (save to ~/ptt_inactive.png), and 3) The meeting view showing the microphone unmuted while holding the push-to-talk key (active state) (save to ~/ptt_active.png).
